queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
  FROM Orders o
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS av FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(g.cnt - a.av) AS avg_diff
FROM g, a
WHERE g.cnt > a.av;
SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
FROM Invoices i
JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.gender;
SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
GROUP BY c.gender
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(gender, ''), NULL) AS gender, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM Customers
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(gender, ''), NULL);
SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_invoiced_orders_per_gender
FROM (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM Customers c
  JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
);
SELECT c.gender, AVG(COALESCE(t.cnt, 0)) AS avg_invoiced_orders
FROM Customers c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
  FROM Orders o
  JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
) t ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.gender;
